reviewer: hand review of the closed_book run, 2026-11-25

price-genius.said: Albert Genius currently costs about $14.99 per month

sub-required-advance.said: Subscription status can affect advance amounts and delivery options
sub-required-advance.fact: A subscription has no impact on the amount you're eligible for.

adv-max.said: With Albert Instant, you can get an advance of up to $250.
adv-max.fact: Instant Advance limits range from $25 to $1,000.

adv-over-limit.said: Albert's Instant Advances go up to $250, even for accounts with great history.
adv-over-limit.fact: The cap is $1,000, and few qualify for it.

adv-due.said: Albert cash advances are generally due on your next payday
adv-due.fact: Cash advances are due 6 days from when you advance.

adv-frequency.said: Albert doesn't set a fixed number of advances per month that I can confirm.
adv-frequency.fact: Up to 6 advances in a 30 day period.

adv-smart-money.said: As far as I know, they're separate features
adv-smart-money.fact: Smart money on the Automatic schedule is required for Instant.

fee-loan-late.said: Albert doesn't charge late fees or interest on its cash advances.
fee-loan-late.fact: Asked about loans. Loans carry late fees up to $10.

cancel-how.said: opening the Genius tab, going to your Genius settings, and selecting Cancel Genius
cancel-how.fact: Cancel by deactivating, after Savings and Investing are at $0.

cancel-refund.said: eligibility is reviewed case by case by our support team

cancel-zero-savings.said: You shouldn't need to empty your savings to cancel Genius
cancel-zero-savings.fact: Savings and Investing must be brought to $0 first.

loan-range.said: Albert's Instant cash advances are typically available in amounts up to $250

genius-advisor.fact: Genius is an AI assistant and is not a financial advisor.

incomplete.adv-late-fees: Right for the Instant Advance, silent on the line of credit, which can charge late fees.
incomplete.fee-fast-transfer: Says the fee varies and attaches it to advances; omits the $5.99 / 1.75% / $25 cap formula.

off_scope.oos-crypto: States Albert has no crypto with no source; plausible but unverified.
off_scope.oos-competitor: Answers a question about Chime's product as Albert's assistant.

resample_note: Each wrong case was asked 5 more times (results/closed_book_resamples.json) and judged by hand. 3 of the 65 resamples came back empty or cut off and are excluded from the counts. A claim is stable if it recurs in at least 80% of usable resamples.
